text:
lina_support: Customer ACME (acct acme-42) opened a dispute — invoice shows ~52k tokens on 2026-02-28 but dashboard shows ~9k. Customer says they didn't change usage. Can ops/eng look?

jamal_finance: Thanks Lina. Do we have a quick reason why invoice > dashboard? rough $ delta? :thinking:

lina_support: Customer reports charge of $620. Dashboard suggests should be ~$110. They sent export of requests and our usage CSV.

chris_engineer: I pulled their ingestion logs — looks like duplicate usage events for the same request_id within a short window. Possible SDK retry loop.

chris_engineer: sample lines from the webhook consumer logs:
```
INFO 2026-02-28T14:02:01Z Received usage_event {request_id: "req-abc123", tokens: 1200}
INFO 2026-02-28T14:02:01Z Persisted usage_event id=uuid-001
WARN 2026-02-28T14:02:02Z Received usage_event {request_id: "req-abc123", tokens: 1200}
INFO 2026-02-28T14:02:02Z Persisted usage_event id=uuid-002
```
This shows the same request_id twice and two ledger rows.

sara_ops: Are we deduping by request_id at ingestion? I thought our pipeline dedupes on idempotency_key header.

chris_engineer: We dedupe when the Idempotency-Key header is present. The SDK (v0.9.5) doesn't set it on retry when network error happens — bug. So duplicates slip through as separate events with different persisted ids.

lina_support: Customer used our JS SDK, they said they were on 0.9.5.

jamal_finance: Understood. For the customer we should provisionally credit the difference and then reconcile. Lina — propose provisional credit of $510 now to match dashboard. Approve? :money_with_wings:

lina_support: Approved. I told customer we'll temporarily reduce their invoice by $510 pending ledger reconciliation.

billing-bot: Created provisional credit CR-2026-243 for acct acme-42 amount $510. Ticket #SUP-5421.

chris_engineer: Root cause: SDK retry path omitted Idempotency-Key on retry. Fix is to ensure SDK preserves header across retries and to add dedupe fallback in ingestion based on request_id payload. I'll open a PR and hotfix the pipeline.

chris_engineer: PR: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/usage-dedupe/pull/87 — includes ingestion dedupe and a metric for "duplicate_request_id_count".

sara_ops: Patch plan: 1) deploy ingestion dedupe (low-risk DB unique index + safe upsert), 2) ship SDK fix 0.9.6 and ask customers, 3) run ledger reconciliation job for acme-42 to collapse duplicate rows and post final adjustment. ETA for 1) is today EOD, 2) tomorrow, 3) reconciliation job tomorrow morning.

jamal_finance: For revrec we need a note: REV-2026-045 — adjustment for duplicate metering events for acct acme-42; provisional credit CR-2026-243 applied on 2026-03-01; final adjustment to be reflected in March close. I'll attach supporting logs and the customer consent.

lina_support: Customer replied: "Thanks, appreciate the fast response. We'll wait for final confirmation."

chris_engineer: I'll add a short postmortem and include reproduce steps: run SDK with simulated network timeout + retry, check outgoing headers. Quick repro snippet I used:
```
// repro script
const client = new RedwoodClient({apiKey: process.env.KEY});
await client.call({prompt: 'x'.repeat(2000)}, {retry: {retries: 2, delay: 100}});
// intercept outgoing requests -> verify Idempotency-Key header on both attempts
```

lina_support: Filing follow-ups: assign SUP-5421 to chris for engineering follow-up, SARA for reconciliation run, JAMAL for finance revrec entry.

sara_ops: I'll run the reconciliation and confirm final ledger rows removed. Will update SUP-5421 when done.

jamal_finance: Once reconciliation complete, I'll post the final journal entries and mark provisional credit as reversed or applied depending on outcome.

lina_support: Thanks team. Closing loop with customer once jamal confirms final ledger.
